title: Bounded interface review
summary: Review a working interface in a small number of complete passes, grouping related visual, usability and responsive defects before editing.
when_to_use: An existing page works but its visual hierarchy, state handling or responsive behavior needs a focused quality pass.
avoid_when: There is no running page or verifiable visual artifact yet; first establish product truth and a working surface.

anatomy.purpose: Captures current desktop and mobile states, including errors and empty states.
Groups issues by severity and shared cause.
Applies related corrections together rather than endless small edits.
Checks the changed surfaces once more against the original defects.

states.name: capture
states.behavior: Gather bounded evidence from representative viewports and interaction states.

states.name: repair
states.behavior: Fix causes in one coherent batch.

states.name: confirm
states.behavior: Verify the repaired states and stop when the acceptance criteria are met.

responsive: Include at least one narrow and one wide viewport when the product is web-based.
accessibility: Include focus, disabled, error and reduced-motion behavior in the same review pass.
implementation_steps: State the target and acceptance criteria.
Capture representative UI states before editing.
Prioritize root causes, implement a bounded repair batch and verify once.
